results.title: Raid 2
results.overview: Set seven years after the events of the first film, it follows the return of IRS officer Amay Patnaik, who is attempting to take down a seemingly benevolent politician.

results.title: Miroirs No. 3
results.overview: After a car crash kills her boyfriend, piano student Laura is taken in by Betty, who witnessed the accident. Living with Betty's family brings comfort, but Laura starts questioning their intentions as time passes.

results.title: Kundschafter des Friedens 2
results.overview: The retired GDR spies have just buried their old mentor in Cuba as they set out to save the last real bastion of socialism. But they didn't expect their biggest opponent so far: full board and Cuba Libre.

results.title: The Gap
results.overview: A lonely barista and a married father slip into a secret romance, where stolen glances turn into passion--and every choice risks breaking their world apart.

results.title: Bayo
results.overview: A new girl in town uses seduction and mind games to tear a loving couple apart. Her motive: lust with a little bit of business.

results.title: Magazine Dreams
results.overview: Aspiring bodybuilder Killian Maddox struggles to find human connection in an exploration of celebrity and violence. Nothing deters him from his fiercely protected dream of superstardom, not even the doctors who warn him of the permanent damage he causes to himself with his quest.

results.title: The Wound
results.overview: Raúl learns of the suicide of Marcela, his high school sweetheart. The shock plunges him into the memory of that winter of 1980 in Buenos Aires. The nostalgic memory of their story revives in the present, like a forgotten love wound that never healed.

results.title: Drunken Blade
results.overview: HAN YUEREN, known as DRUNKEN BLADE in Jianghu, traveled to a desolate desert town to repay the kindness of a meal back then. At the time, the town was being ravaged by swords bandits. The killing intent of Lady Boss also emerges.

results.title: Lake George
results.overview: Four years after a heist gone wrong, two childhood friends, Rio and Psych, are thrust into a high-stakes journey. When Psych discovers his imprisoned father is being held for ransom with only 24 hours to pay $100,000, the pair embarks on a desperate mission to secure the funds.

results.title: Divino Assassino
results.overview: Betina lives with her father Adamastor, but he is fascinated by the teachings of the mysterious New World cult. Despite being the newest member and receiving a suspicious message, she still goes to a party with her friends Jorge, Pietra and Lucas, but there things start to change.

results.title: Treasure Hunters: On the Tracks of Khufu
results.overview: An eccentric archaeologist goes on an unexpected journey to find King Khufu's lost treasure with his daughter and grandson.

results.title: Apolo
results.overview: After naturally conceiving a child during the COVID-19 pandemic, trans-centered couple Isis and Lourenzo begin a journey across Brazil in search of respectful and specialized prenatal care, while fighting for their family's rights in what kills the most trans people in the world.

results.title: Aporia
results.overview: When her partner starts speaking word salad, despite everyone else understanding him perfectly, a woman must find a way to reconnect without words before their inability to communicate pulls them apart forever.

results.title: Karim
results.overview: Karim, a devoted husband and father, loses everything when his construction business collapses, leaving only an old meatball stall inherited from his father. Unable to cope with poverty, his wife Watik leaves him and takes their young daughter, Arum. Desperate to rebuild his life and reunite with his family, Karim is persuaded by his younger brother, Heri, to perform a forbidden ritual promising wealth. As fortune returns, the ritual’s terrifying consequences begin to surface, forcing Karim to confront a deadly price that threatens his family and his own life.

results.title: Noseeums
results.overview: Fresh from her toxic relationship, a curious college student, Ember reluctantly agrees to a weekend trip with her roommate and wealthy white "friends" to a secluded lake house in the Florida backwoods. Once she arrives at this unsettling land, it becomes familiar as she unearths troubled spirits that owned it and seeks to reclaim it

results.title: Lucca's World
results.overview: Determined to help her son, who has cerebral palsy, Bárbara takes her family to India for an experimental treatment.

results.title: Reflection in a Dead Diamond
results.overview: When the mysterious woman in the room next door disappears, a debonair 70-year-old ex-spy living in a luxury hotel on the Côte d'Azur is confronted by the demons and darlings of a lurid past in which moviemaking, memories and madness collide.

results.title: Norma: Antara Mertua dan Menantu
results.overview: When a young woman learns of an affair between her mother and her husband, she faces a difficult decision: forgive or seek justice.
